hook: Apple wants an AI agent that uses your Mac.
hookText: Apple is building a Mac AI agent

beats.say: Bloomberg spotted an Apple job listing for a senior engineering manager to build an AI agent that can use a computer.
The posting says it browses the web, works across apps, runs commands, writes and debugs code, and does it all privately.
Meanwhile, macOS 27.3 will warn users against granting full access to third-party agents, as Anthropic, OpenAI and Meta's Muse push into the space.
